model: abs11 A1 big-day LR without the cross-instrument stress feature (attention only, no direction)
status: research preview; abs11 A1 FAILED its preregistered operating rule on every instrument; NOT qualified; display only
target: session max |excursion| from the 22:00 UTC open >= 0.9384% of the open
population: valid sessions (>= 8 30-min bars), 30-min bar closes before the session excursion reaches T1

feature_definitions.session: day key = floor((t_min + 120) / 1440): sessions roll at 22:00 UTC; 30-min mid bars ((bid+ask)/2 per field) from M1; valid session >= 8 bars
feature_definitions.rv1/rv5/rv22: log(mean over the previous 1/5/22 valid sessions of RV_d + 1e-4), RV_d = 100*sqrt(sum of squared 30-min log returns in session d; first bar uses log(c/o))
feature_definitions.rv_so: log(100*sqrt(sum of squared 30-min log returns so far in the session) + 1e-4)
feature_definitions.rv6h: log(100*sqrt(sum of squared 30-min log returns of bars opening in the last 360 min) + 1e-4)
feature_definitions.exc_so: 100*max(high_so - open, open - low_so)/open, session so far
feature_definitions.rng_norm: log((range_so% + 1e-4)/(median range_so% at the same 30-min slot over the previous 60 valid sessions (min 20) + 1e-4))
feature_definitions.gap: 100*|session open - previous valid session close| / previous close

refit: quarterly expanding, rows with session day < quarter start - 5 days
